name: Akebi Atsuyu
source:
"Do whatever you want, so long as it doesn’t involve me. I have a duty to fulfill, and you will not get in my way."

Younger prince of Vampiredom.

[From [url=https://twitter.com/sinxholic/status/1649607037611921408]Twitter[/url]]
